newsitem.title: USA: Delta Air seen naming Leo Mullion CEO - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Delta Air seen naming Leo Mullion CEO - WSJ.

text.p: Delta Air Lines was expected to name Unicom Corp vice chairman Leo Mullin as its new president and chief executive Friday, the Wall Street Journal reported.
The move will be the first time Delta named a chief executive from outside the company, the Journal said.
The move is also a sign the company, which has long exhibited a cautious and insular culture, intends to reshape itself, according to the Journal.
Mullin, 54, is not expected to be named Delta's chairman, the newspaper said.
He would replace longtime chief executive Ronald Allen, who left Delta last April.
